name: Unnamed Battlegrounds
desc:
Please like and favorite game for more updates in future. 🙏💘

💻[ Controls ] 
LMB - punch
G - awakening
F - block
Q - dash
Q (while ragdolled) - evasive
B - emote wheel

All game characters are stickmen, original or from the game, anime.

Game is available on All Devices.
